notes: kernel_sources currently mounts THIS kernel's own previous output: the first run ended PARTIAL (~92 files short after retries) and the notebook resumes from the mounted partial tar, downloading only the remainder.

Stages the even-indexed sequences (sorted) of the SportsMOT test split -> sportsmot-test-1.tar. Its sibling prepare-data-2 stages the other, MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE half — the full split (~95k files, ~21 GB) exceeds Kaggle's 20 GB kernel-output cap, so it ships as two disjoint halves that testing/index mounts together.

slug=null -> the kaggle service runner derives the kernel name: <model>-<type> for index, <model>-<type>-<name> otherwise. Kernels live in a Kaggle collection named after the model (maintained in the UI — the API has no collections endpoint).
CPU-only on purpose (enable_gpu=false): downloading data must not burn GPU quota.
To resume a PARTIAL run, add this kernel's own slug to kernel_sources so the previous version's tar is mounted; the notebook auto-detects it and downloads only the remainder.
external-secrets provides HF_TOKEN for higher Hub rate limits (works without it too).
